summary: Full backend + frontend smoke/integration testing of Distro Logistics. 37/37 pytest backend tests passed (auth, products CRUD, orders flow + RBAC + data isolation, status transitions, analytics admin+supplier, admin user mgmt, messaging, notifications, profile). Frontend: demo-login buttons for all 3 roles routed to correct dashboards (/catalog, /supplier, /admin). Retailer catalog shows seeded products; order-product -> confirm-add-cart -> /cart -> place-order-btn navigates to /orders successfully (end-to-end order placement works). Supplier dashboard shows revenue series + popular items + low stock + add-product-btn visible. Admin dashboard displays GMV/orders/fulfillment/fees/pending counts and 2 approve-supplier buttons rendered. theme-toggle and notification-bell both present and wired.

ui_bugs.issue: Textarea for delivery warehouse address has no data-testid (e.g. delivery-address); hinders automation. Pre-filled from profile so order still placed.

issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on initial render — chart container needs minWidth/minHeight or defined aspect
Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description — accessibility warning
Some elements rendered with empty string src attribute causing React warning (likely when product.image is empty)

action_items: Add data-testid="delivery-address" to Cart delivery address textarea for testability
Guard or skip rendering when empty to remove empty-string src warning
Add aria-describedby/DialogDescription to product order Dialog and other DialogContent instances
Set explicit min width/height (or aspect) on Recharts ResponsiveContainer in SupplierDashboard to silence (-1,-1) warnings
critical_code_review_comments: seed.py timeline-building code has a confusing nested ternary (line ~121); logic works but is fragile and hard to read
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); switch to lifespan context manager
CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False — acceptable since JWT in Authorization header (not cookies); fine
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout) — not implemented, but auth is Bearer JWT not cookie-based so playbook rule is less strict here
Order stock decrement is not atomic/transactional and does not check availability — negative stock possible if two orders race
